title: Build the site cyclotron definition from the Section list
description: Backend. One CyclotronDefinition for the whole site: one binary classifier per enabled NewsroomSection (question and rubric seeded from the Section's editorial mission, policy and kill criteria) and one multi-class 'section' classifier whose labels are the Section ids. Config: relevanceCyclotron stays for the relevance question; add siteCyclotron with the same enabled flag, daily cap and approvedProofPath. Replaces the single-classifier assumption (classifiers[0]) across relevance_sweep, relevance_decisions and relevance_shadow.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Applied 11-02: some sections are formats, not topics (Distinctive's Before You File, Pilobolus's Field Notes), so no Reference should be classified into them. NewsroomSection has no setting for this, and the sweep derives a classifier from every enabled section. Add a per-section switch when the site cyclotron definition is built.
